question: The ________ rate measures rising prices in everything except food and energy.
solution:
The correct answer is __**core inflation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The core inflation rate measures rising prices in everything except food and energy**__.

 
 
• The prime rate does not include food and energy prices because they vary greatly each month.
 
• This exclusion makes the main rate more accur
